exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Inter-Process Communication
exploitedBy.relevance: Directly relates to exploiting IPC channels, where missing mutual authentication allows unauthorized processes to communicate.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Remote Services
exploitedBy.relevance: Lack of mutual authentication on IPC channels mirrors the risk of unauthenticated access to remote services.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Proc Memory
exploitedBy.relevance: Attackers can manipulate shared memory regions without integrity checks, similar to proc memory injection techniques.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: Capturing IPC messages for replay requires intercepting/sniffing the communication, analogous to network sniffing.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exploitation for Credential Access
exploitedBy.relevance: Exposed unauthenticated D-Bus methods can be exploited to gain credentials or escalate privileges.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: System Services
exploitedBy.relevance: D-Bus services often mediate system service interactions; unauthenticated exposure can allow abuse of system services.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Path Interception by Unquoted Path
exploitedBy.relevance: Named pipe squatting is conceptually similar to path interception, where an attacker pre-creates a resource at an expected location.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: OS Exhaustion Flood
exploitedBy.relevance: Without rate limiting, IPC endpoints are vulnerable to flooding attacks that exhaust OS resources.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Digital Certificates
exploitedBy.relevance: Absence of proper TLS certificates on RPC channels relates to the misuse or absence of digital certificates for securing communications.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Protocol Tunneling
exploitedBy.relevance: Weak TLS on loopback RPC can be exploited to tunnel malicious traffic through the unprotected RPC channel.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol
exploitedBy.relevance: Sensitive data present in unprotected IPC headers can be exfiltrated over unencrypted protocols by a local attacker.
